Any changes in the unit types will be updated in the quarterly updates to be given on the website. Further, the construction of the units start after signing of agreement with the buyers hence the date of completion of the project is dependent of sale of the unit. The Club House is under construction which is not part of this sanctioned layout. There are another 302 plots which have not been opened for sale, and which will be launched at a later date. These will be treated as separate Phase(s) and will be registered as a New Project with the RERA website prior to launch, in keeping with the Rules.
